body.statement: In the randomized-treatment model of Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes, Assumption A requires random treatment assignment, Assumption B requires \(S(1)\geq S(0)\) unit by unit, the always-employed stratum is \(EE=\{S(0)=S(1)=1\}\), and Proposition 1 gives lower and upper quantile-treatment-effect bounds for that stratum under Assumptions A--B.

source.locator: Assumption A on p. 9, Assumption B on pp. 12--13, and Proposition 1 on pp. 17--18 of IZA Discussion Paper 6065, corresponding to the published article

attestation.note: Verified against Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes, Assumptions A--B and Proposition 1; the node records only the randomized-treatment, monotone-employment, always-employed comparison.
